The '''Baragwin Disruptor-X weapon''' was a [[Disruptor rifle/Legends|disruptor rifle]] of [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] design that had been extensively modified by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Suvam Tan]]. Similar to his [[Baragwin Ion-X weapon]], the most significant alteration was the incorporation of a ''shaped-energy'' delivery system that delivered concussive force in addition to normal energy discharge.
